text_block_list.text:
One day, Victoire Pisa was looking through 
some fan letters she'd received, when 
suddenly...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Hmm...
choice_data_list: Did it say something bad in there?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Ah, no, that's not the case at all.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Everyone has written so thoughtfully. I 
can feel their supportive feelings almost 
painfully well... Howeverâ

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Sometimes, people write to me saying I'm 
"like an angel." I find that so 
bewildering...
choice_data_list:
Maybe your care for others is getting 
through to them.

I wonder if your feelings for others are 
getting through.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Is that so...? It's more praise than I 
deserve, but I'm very glad to hear it.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Still... calling me an 'angel' is 
definitely too much praise. It makes me 
feel so presumptuous.

A few days later, while out in town with 
Victoire Pisa.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, we found some great shoes. I can't 
wait to try them out—
(Vroooom...)

text_block_list.name: Passerby
text_block_list.text:
Ah, heeeey! You dropped this!! ...Is it 
okay to leave it? It's wrapped so nicely, 
though.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Ngh! Trainer! I—
choice_data_list:
Make sure you run in the dedicated 
Umamusume lane!

Make sure you run in the dedicated 
Umamusume lane!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Right, here I go! Look right! Look left! 
Clear to run!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Passersby
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, did she just chase after a 
motorcycle?" "She could've just handed it 
to the police box..." "Doing that without 
a second thought, man..."

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Um... did you happen to drop this?

text_block_list.name: Owner of the Lost Item
text_block_list.text:
Ah, huh? Whoa! When did I drop this!? 
...Did you run all the way to bring it to 
me?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I was just in the middle of a run, 
so please don't worry about it.

text_block_list.name: Owner of the Lost Item
text_block_list.text:
"In your school uniform...? A-Anyway, 
thank you! It's a precious present. It 
chills me to the bone just thinking about 
losing it..."

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Oh, is that so! In that case, I'm glad I 
could deliver it to you.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Please continue to be careful after this 
as well. They say it's easy to lose focus 
right after an accident.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
I hope the present arrives safely. And 
that her feelings reach them too...
choice_data_list: Good work. You did a good deed.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
No, nothing special. If one has the means, 
it is only natural to want to help someone 
in need.

Actions like these might be why her fans 
call her an "angel." Or so the thought 
crossed my mind.
